{{External|rs|rsc=Black Plate Mail Body|dw=Black Knight Platebody}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black platebody |image = [[File:Black platebody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = Provides excellent protection. |value = 3840 |weight = 9.979 |exchange = Yes |id = 1125 }} [[File:Black platebody detail.png|150px|left]] The '''black platebody''' is an [[Black equipment|armour]] used in [[melee]] with the same stat bonuses as a [[white platebody]], excluding the [[Prayer]] bonus. It requires 10 [[Defence]] to equip and provides greater protection than a [[black chainbody]]. Like all [[Platebody|platebodies]], however, it gives a crippling negative bonus to the user's [[Ranged]] and [[Magic]] stats. It cannot be made using the [[Smithing]] [[skill]], though it's easily obtainable as it can be bought from [[Horvik]], [[Zenesha]] or another player. A black platebody is used in [[King's Ransom]] and [[Heroes' Quest]] if the player joins the [[Black Arm Gang]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -30 |arange = -15 |dstab = 41 |dslash = 40 |dcrush = 30 |dmagic = -6 |drange = 40 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Black platebody equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Black platebody equipped female.png|120px]] }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black platebody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black platebody}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black platebody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The platebody's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -10 to -15. }} {{Subject changes |date = 7 March 2005 |update = Mountain Daughter and Changes |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black platebody detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black platebody detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black platebody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black platebody (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black platebody (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Black platebody.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
